resources.string: Lets you talk to JARVIS and, if you turn it on, listen for the wake word. Audio is processed on this phone for wake-word detection; speech-to-text uses Android\'s own recogniser.
Needed to show reminders, timers and the "JARVIS is listening" status. Without it a reminder can still ring, but you may not see it.
Lets JARVIS find "Mom" or "Priya" in your contacts when you ask it to call or message someone. Contacts are looked up on this phone and are not uploaded.
Lets JARVIS start a call directly and answer or end calls when you ask. Without it, JARVIS opens the dialer with the number filled in and you press call.
Needed for the Dynamic-Island-style bar at the top of the screen, and lets Android open apps for you while JARVIS is in the background.
Lets JARVIS read incoming notifications aloud, show what is playing, and reply to chat notifications on request. It stays off until you enable it, and you can switch it off any time.
Only used for the system actions you ask for: Home, Back, Recents, the notification shade, lock screen and screenshot. JARVIS does not read what is on your screen.
Lets reminders and timers ring at the exact minute. Without it Android may delay them by several minutes.
Needed to change screen brightness for you.
Needed to turn Do Not Disturb on or off when you ask.
Lets an alarm-style reminder light up the screen when the phone is locked.
Many phones stop background apps to save power. Allowing unrestricted use makes always-on listening and reminders more reliable. Some brands need an extra setting; see the Background listening guide.
Makes JARVIS open when you long-press Home or use the assistant gesture. Android asks you to pick it under Default apps → Digital assistant app.
Some requests show personal information, so JARVIS asks you to unlock the phone first. JARVIS never bypasses your lock screen.
Needed for web search, weather, image generation and cloud AI providers.
Open-ended chat and writing need at least one AI provider. Add a key in Settings → AI providers.
The app you asked for isn\'t installed on this phone.
Reminders, alarms and timers that are due.
Shows that JARVIS is listening for the wake word.
Answers and results from requests made while the screen is off.
Android doesn\'t allow apps to start the microphone after a restart. Tap here to turn wake-word listening back on.
Missed while the phone was off
Saved in JARVIS\'s private storage (shared Documents folder wasn\'t available)
